statement: Bounded sector-structure enumeration scans factor counts 0..3 and ranks 1..4, giving 35 candidate structures.
Closure requires nontrivial chirality, anomaly cancellation, Witten parity where relevant, finite charge-grid closure, and minimality.
Exactly one minimal closing structure is generated: ranks 1|2 and dimensions 2|3.
The generated dimensions 2|3 recognition-land on the SM gauge-sector shape after the audit, up to factor order.
Abelian-only, real-rep-only, and single-complex-factor controls do not close; Stage II checks pass.
Finite enumeration only; not an E019 closure, not a physical gauge-sector theorem, and no frame-transfer status upgrade.
